title: Georgia Possible NDE 3917
content: I was twelve years old and on a vacation with my family. It was at the height of the summer and very hot. We were visiting my grandparents on my father's side who lived in a village in the Middle East. I was bareheaded out in the fields in blazing sun. My family and other relatives were preparing for a picnic. We were having a barbeque. But I was awful tired and just wanted to rest all the time, and I was feeling so cold. My father told me to stop being so mawkish and behave. He didn't realize how sick I actually was. Finally, one of the adults persuaded my father to send me home. It wasn't that far from home, about half a kilometer, but I was feeling so bad at that time and hardly remember how I got home. There were my uncle and his wife. They wondered why I came home. I told them that I was so very cold and wanted to lie down. The last thing I remember when I still was awake was that several blankets were put on me because of the shivers I had. Until this very day, I remember the meeting with the incredibly kind figure who wore a long cloak or mantle. I think it was a male figure, maybe an angel, but without visible wings. I clearly remember the question he asked me, 'Are you ready to cross over?' I knew somehow that there wasn't any return if I did that. I almost felt embarrassed and ungrateful to the friendly figure when I said, 'Mom and dad need me, besides we will go back to Sweden in a few days.' I don't remember if I said that in words or by telepathy. Immediately after that, I woke up. My grandmother was trying to lower the fever by using large rhubarb-looking leaves on my bare body. Six months after this experience there was buzzing in my ears. Eight years later, due to my education, I came in touch with the book 'Life After Life' by Raymond Moody. I can guarantee that the book gave me shivers of recognition. Finally, I realized that I had had an NDE. Unfortunately I can't remember any tunnel. Just the light that was out of this world, and the meeting with the figure (or angel).

arrival.other_being_detail: Incredibly kind figure, likely male, wearing a long cloak or mantle; experiencer thought it might be an angel but without visible wings.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe fever/heat illness while in blazing sun; shivering and later described as grandmother trying to lower the fever.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel or OBE described; experience centered on an otherworldly light and a kind cloaked figure asking if the experiencer was ready to cross over, followed by immediate waking.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Figure asked a direct question: 'Are you ready to cross over?' Experiencer declined due to parents needing them and upcoming return to Sweden; later (six months) buzzing in ears reported.
